apiBaseUrl.title: NotiRx API address
apiBaseUrl.description: HTTPS base URL of the NotiRx API, without a trailing slash. Example: https://xxxx.execute-api.ca-central-1.amazonaws.com/prod

apiKey.title: NotiRx API key
apiKey.description: API key for this pharmacy. Set it in enterprise policy on the managed computers. Do not put it in the extension files or in git.
